title: Github Metric2 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:metric2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day github metric2 (2) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on github metric2 (2) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It scans what time of day your github metric2 (2) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
